leadText:
The Banana Slakoth Garden (Japanese: バナナナマケロ園 Banana Garden) is an -exclusive location in Hoenn found between Fortree City and Lilycove City. 

The garden is a large banana plantation and boasts the largest population in the world. The bananas, aside from feeding the Slakoth, also go into making banana-flavored desserts for visitors to enjoy.

The garden appeared in The Garden of Eatin, where it was in danger of closing because a was eating all of the bananas. After receiving some questions from and , Marcel, the garden's director, realized that Snorlax was displaced from its mountain home due to an encroaching construction site that was set up a month ago. In addition to eating all of the food, Snorlax used its to make other Pokémon fall . Marcel used his newly evolved to oppose Snorlax; Vigoroth's rendered Yawn ineffective. Marcel later Snorlax and created a relaxation attraction featuring Snorlax's Yawn move. Since there is now a Vigoroth in the garden, Marcel decided to rename it the "Banana Slakoth and Vigoroth Garden".
